title: Feedback needed - which screenshots should I use on the App Store?
author: Appropriate-Value610
selftext:
Hello! I'm a solo dev working on Mad Snake, an iOS retro arcade snake game for iPhone.

I'm reviewing my current screenshots on the App Store as I want to improve conversion/downloads.

I want to keep only the Top 5 most engaging screenshots. Please see the 9 screenshots attached. 

In your opinion, what are the top 5 that I should use?

comments.author: soldture
comments.body: The last one is good, catching the attention

replies.author: Appropriate-Value610
replies.body: Cool, thanks for the feedback! Looks like many people enjoyed the last one (9) 😃

comments.author: balazs8921
comments.body: The second. At first glance, it shows what the game is about.

replies.author: Appropriate-Value610
replies.body: Appreciate the feedback, noted. You selected 1, what would be the other 4 you liked?

comments.author: x10der_by
comments.body: Another Snake game? Would you play it on your phone if you saw it in the store?

replies.author: Appropriate-Value610
replies.body: Yes, I would play! You didn't answer my question, though...

comments.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
comments.body: This post is not specific to AI based game development. See rule #1.
